g.text: PCB layout audit · A1 development board
Revised placement and routing. Actual front copper and silkscreen; overlays show measured paths.
Orange: D4 VIN return to T1 = 6.91 mm
Snubber SW branch = 4.05 mm on F.Cu; no added SW vias or buried SW route.
Input feed: 34.87 → 6.70 mm. Clamp return: 57.54 → 6.91 mm.
Output feed: 33.20 → 11.04 mm. Ground stitching and two exposed ground probe lands added.
Local bias: 1.69 mm. Feedback: 1.72 mm. Bench overshoot, ripple and thermal tests remain open.
Measurements: explicit routed centerlines; exclude windings, plane spreading and component internals.
Clean DRC establishes checked geometry. It does not establish loop inductance, EMI, temperature or regulation.
